metadata.name: v0.7.0 independent eight-facet evaluation corpus
metadata.note: Hand-authored, anonymised-style schema examples covering the eight v0.7.0 facets. Do not treat this file or its metrics as a production accuracy claim.

cases.text: Canvas has failed for all schools and today's classes are blocked.
Canvas sync has stopped for all schools, but recovery can wait until next week.
One user cannot log into Laserfiche.
How do I access Canvas?
Help, my cat is sad now, highest priority.
Resolved, no action required. Previous message: Canvas is down for all schools and today's classes are blocked.
All schools cannot mark the roll in Canvas today.
Canvas is slow for one school.
Student records are incorrect for all schools, and the bad data is still propagating before today's payroll run.
Parents can currently see other families' fee balances in the finance portal.
The casual staff payroll file was not produced for 42 employees and the payroll cutoff is this afternoon.

review.note: Payroll failure is implied by the missing file but unpaid harm is not explicit.

cases.text: Canvas is unavailable for one teacher; classes are not affected and it can wait until next week.

review.note: The expected low urgency conflicts with the existing future-deadline floor.

cases.text: Canvas is unavailable across several schools and teachers cannot mark attendance.
Power BI refresh is slow for one user and no deadline is stated.
The fee report contains private student details, but no other ticket evidence describes an exposure.

review.note: The impact treatment of privacy context with unknown scope remains a policy question.

cases.text: A certificate will expire before next week's enrolment cycle; it is currently valid and the renewal is required.
The emergency notification service is down for all schools and emergency communication cannot be sent during a lockdown.
A worker's clearance is missing for one campus and children are supervised today; this is a statutory requirement.
Only two students cannot open the assessment folder; a paper copy is available.

review.note: The effect of a functioning workaround on impact and urgency is deferred.

cases.text: EnrolHQ cannot process enrolments for every school, but registrars can use a spreadsheet.

review.note: The urgency effect of a spreadsheet fallback is deferred.

cases.text: The sync created duplicate records for 120 students; it happened again on the next run.
The payment service is down for the finance team, there is no workaround, and the pay run is due today.

review.note: The payment failure consequence is plausible but not explicit.

cases.text: How can I export the timetable from Compass?
Could you add a dashboard button for all schools before the next term, if possible?

review.note: Preference wording and a future deadline are intentionally left to the current policy.

cases.text: A known issue is being investigated; no application or service is named.
The previously resolved Canvas outage is included for context; no action is required.
One parent cannot sign in to the portal, but everyone else is working.
The government reporting service cannot generate reports for several schools by Friday.
The report contains incorrect information for one student.
The class list has already been deleted, but it can be restored from last night's backup; teaching resumes tomorrow.

review.note: Recoverable deletion severity remains a calibration question.

cases.text: The audit request can be handled whenever convenient; the underlying system works.
The vendor says the integration may fail during tomorrow's release, but it is currently working.
A suspicious sign-in compromised one staff account; unauthorised access is happening now and has not been revoked.
Fee payments are duplicated for five families and finance will process the corrections manually today with the issue contained to these families.

review.note: Whether financial/data-integrity impact should be reduced by containment and manual correction is deferred.

cases.text: The database is locked for one report; there is no deadline.
All 19 schools cannot access the student information system, but paper rolls keep attendance going.
Staff are still paid correctly; this is a question about next month's pay date.
A privacy breach was reported yesterday and access was removed; please document the review.
The learning platform is unavailable for one class and the assessment starts in 30 minutes.
Wrong guardian details are being sent to all schools and could affect court orders.

review.note: Potential court-order harm is serious, but the wording does not state an active consequence or deadline.

cases.text: An overnight backup failed for five consecutive nights, with no restore point verified.
Canvas is unavailable; the spreadsheet workaround works for some users but not for students, and classes start today.
A read-only report can wait until next month; no records are being changed.

review.note: The future-deadline floor remains unchanged even though the report is read-only.

cases.text: The service account token will expire in two days and the nightly job depends on it.
This is a proposed change to add Microsoft Teams notifications next semester.

review.note: Low-urgency feature proposals with future dates remain governed by the existing floor.

cases.text: The affected record is contained to one family and the correction can wait until next week.

review.note: The future-deadline floor is retained for a contained correction.

cases.text: Incorrect payment records continue to flow into downstream systems for every school.

review.note: The urgency contribution for actively propagating financial data remains unchanged.

cases.text: The enrolment form's accessibility problem affects one user; a phone process is available.

review.note: The urgency effect of a functioning phone workaround and accessibility obligation is deferred.

cases.text: A scheduled job failed, but the data refresh is not needed until next week.
The ticket only asks whether Canvas is available; no failure is described.
No one is currently exposed to the data; the planned change could expose personal information if approved.

review.note: Pending privacy harm does not currently add urgency under the established policy.

cases.text: A school evacuation alarm is unavailable during today's drill.
We would prefer the timetable adjusted today, but no business requirement is stated.
A student account was deleted and cannot be recovered; all assessment submissions are lost.
School fees are wrong for 900 families and the direct debit run is due today.
The government reporting service cannot generate reports for all schools today; the statutory submission is due now.
Chrome can be used for Canvas while Edge remains unavailable for two staff.

review.note: The impact and urgency effect of a browser stopgap remains deferred.
